native_mechanisms: Silence-swats: the marks' order is fixed/laid down positionally before any heap is folded, so order is never lost in mixing

Each heap races the musk deer's mountain stride — uphill twist (rotate), downhill fold (xor), doubling-back that eats its own trail (feedback) — carried forward into the next heap, so no heap keeps the shape it entered with
Searching in squares: turn the shape ninety degrees and fold its corners into its own centre, repeatedly, until one changed mark smears across every square (avalanche/corner test)
The owl seals the final folded shape to one fixed small size while every intermediate heap is burned, so the token cannot be walked back to its marks (irreversible fixed-width finalisation)
core_technique: Sponge-style absorbing hash over a 16x64-bit (4x4) state: each 64-byte block is XOR-ed into the rate lanes, then permuted by 4 double-rounds of the BLAKE2b G function applied column-wise (add/xor/rotate-32,24,16,63) interleaved with an AES-like ShiftRows lane rotation, followed by a 12-layer finalisation permutation and an XOR-rotate fold to 64 bits — with a separate splitmix64/xxHash-class multiply-xor-shift accumulator only for buffers under 64 bytes.
